name: Radish Rig
tagline: Grow embarrassing amounts of salad in a closet you're not using anyway.
positioning: A countertop-to-closet vertical farm and app for people who want fresh basil without becoming insufferable about it.

hero.h1: You have killed 14 basil plants. This one is smarter than you.
hero.sub: Radish Rig is a self-watering, self-lighting vertical farm plus an app that texts you before your greens stage a revolt. Fresh harvest in 3 weeks, zero dirt under your nails.

features.title: It waters so you won't forget
features.description: Sensors track moisture, pH, and nutrients, then dose everything on a schedule. You are officially demoted from 'plant parent' to 'plant landlord.'

features.title: Sunlight, but on a subscription
features.description: Full-spectrum LED tuned per crop. Your lettuce gets a perfect summer while it's sleeting outside and you're eating a real salad about it.

features.title: Harvest nudges, not guilt trips
features.description: The app pings you the moment your arugula peaks so you crop it at flavor, not at 'oh no it bolted again.'

features.title: Recipes for whatever survived
features.description: Grown more mint than any human needs? The app suggests what to cook before it becomes a compost origin story.

testimonials.quote: I told my roommate I'd start cooking. Three weeks later there's a jungle of Thai basil in our hallway closet and I have opinions about pesto now. Nobody asked, but here we are.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: I run a 12-seat supper club out of my flat. Radish Rig means microgreens on demand instead of a panicked 6am trip to a market that's closed. My food cost dropped and my ego rose.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: Bought it as a gimmick, kept it because the harvest reminders are less judgmental than my mother. I've now grown salad I did not immediately let die. Growth, both literal and personal.
testimonials.name: Elena Whitfield

pricing.blurb: One rig, one closet, a suspicious new amount of herbs.
For the person who now brings salad to potlucks unprompted.
You've stopped buying greens entirely. The store misses you.

homepage.footerBlurb: Radish Rig: fresh greens for people who mean well but travel a lot. Grown indoors, harvested smugly, watered by robots that don't forget.
